newsitem.title: USA: Patriot American completes 1.38 mln shr sale.
newsitem.headline: Patriot American completes 1.38 mln shr sale.

text.p: Patriot American Hospitality Inc said Friday that its underwriters have exercised their over-allotment option to purchase an additional 1.38 million shares of common stock, following its August 1 offering of 9.2 million shares at $24 each.
Net proceeds from the exercise of the over-allotment are expected to total about $31.4 million, and net proceeds from the entire offering are expected to be about $241 million.
The proceeds, said the company, are being used principally to reduce debt incurred on the companies' revolving credit facility.
Shares of Patriot American closed Friday at 24-9/16, down 1/8.
Patriot American is a real estate investment trust with a portfolio of 64 hotels and resorts.
